'''Otsock''' was an alias that was used by a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
The Togorian was a member of the [[Fireclaw Horde]], a Togorian criminal gang, and she accompanied the Horde when they began operating in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While under the alias of Otsock and in disguise as a [[Duckonian]], the Togorian participated as a [[Swoop racing/Legends|racer]] in the [[Cularin Classic]], a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racing event that the Horde planned to attack. During the race, the Togorian flew a [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[JR-4 swoop/Legends|JR-4 swoop]].
